condition_other: spastic cerebral palsy (intracranial ethanol injection model)
direction_notes: The authors state results were not yet sufficient to assert ultrasound neuromodulation as a therapy for spasticity at these parameters.
safety_notes: Several rats died after the model surgery; no ultrasound-related adverse events are described.

exposures.label: Transcranial ultrasound over the ethanol injection site (pyramidal tract region)

target.label: the area where the ethanol was injected

device.manufacturer: KLD Biosistemas Equipamentos Eletronicos, Amparo, SP, Brazil

timing.protocol_description: Continuous emission mode for 5 seconds at 1 MHz, once per day for seven days, starting 72 hours after surgery, applied transcranially with water-filled adapter and gel.
